title: atlas.config.json
description: Configuration for a repository's Atlas — which folders map to which vault modules, which optional modules are enabled, which owns resolver classes are active, retrieval exclusions, and which lifecycle hooks are enabled. See docs/CONFIG.md for the full field-level writeup and recipes.

$schema.description: Editor-tooling pointer to this schema file, e.g. "./node_modules/memory-atlas/schema/atlas.config.schema.json". Ignored by the loader.

version.description: Config shape version. Bumps only on a breaking shape change; unrelated to the package's own semver.

enabled.description: Master kill switch. false: every `atlas` subcommand except `init` prints nothing and exits 0, and adapter scripts (e.g. the ctx-search index refresher) exit immediately. Safe default behavior for a repo that vendored the convention but paused it.

vaultDir.description: Repo-relative path to the vault directory, conventionally `<repo>-atlas`. Informational for companion tools — this CLI always discovers the vault by structure (a directory containing map/index.md or map/zones/), never by trusting this field blindly.

folders.description: Vault-relative paths (relative to vaultDir) for each note-type module. Remapping any entry is free — e.g. `"ideas": "notes/sparks"` — every loader resolves through this map.

drafts.description: Human scratch space, excluded from agent retrieval by default (module: drafts).

templates.description: Per-type note scaffolds; also where `atlas routine` looks for a vault's own routines/ subfolder.

modules.description: Optional vault modules beyond the core skeleton. Each is created on first use or by an explicit `atlas init --modules` flag — an Atlas must not scaffold an optional module empty by default.

anchors.description: Optional owns.* resolver classes beyond the always-on owns.globs. Each MUST be declared here before a verifier enforces it (SPEC.md §5).

testids.description: owns.testids — grep for a configured attribute under a configured root.

tools.description: owns.tools — grep for the id under a configured registry root.

pattern.description: {id} is substituted with each tool id.

root.description: git pathspec to search under; empty means the whole repository.

routes.description: owns.routes — match against configured route-file globs (SOFT severity: unresolved routes warn, they don't hard-fail).

stripPrefix.description: Literal prefix stripped from each matched file path before route comparison.

stripSuffix.description: Regex (as a string) stripped from the end of each matched file path.

strictFreshness.description: When true, `atlas check` behaves as if `--strict` were always passed: any stale zone fails the command. Lets a repo opt CI into blocking on staleness without every caller remembering the flag; local default usage stays non-blocking.

engine.description: Which retrieval adapter this repo documents/uses. Informational in v0.1 — no engine is ever required.

excludeFromSearch.description: Vault-relative folder names (trailing slash) hidden from automatic agent-facing indexing/search/orientation sweeps. Hidden, not sealed — an agent explicitly asked to read a specific excluded file may still do so.

skills.description: Where this repo keeps its Atlas-navigation skills and which one is the entry ramp.

dir.description: Repo-relative directory the navigation skills are copied into.

nav.description: Name of the entry-ramp navigation skill.

hooks.description: Per-hook toggles (SPEC.md Interop — the SessionStart hook contract). Each SessionStart helper checks its own toggle and exits 0 silently when false.

sessionStartStatus.description: Whether `atlas status --hook` prints. A plain `atlas status` (no --hook) always prints, regardless of this toggle — it only governs the hook call site.

sessionStartIndexRefresh.description: Whether the ctx-search adapter's SessionStart invocation (no flags) spawns its background reindex worker.

routines.description: Self-maintenance prompt templates (`atlas routine`). This package never schedules anything — routines are prompts the user runs by hand or schedules with their own tool.

enabled.description: Whether this repo has opted into scheduling routines externally; informational (this package never reads it to trigger anything itself).

cadenceDays.description: Substituted into a routine template's {{CADENCE_DAYS}} placeholder.

tasks.description: Which built-in/vault routine names this repo runs on its cadence.
